implementation: Round 2 Receiving Manager (TypeScript, copied unchanged into round2/) run through a thin Python adapter (app.py + bridge.ts). One blind Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite vision call per unit describes the photos without seeing the PO; deterministic code compares that with the PO line and gives 9 per-check PASS / FAIL / UNCERTAIN verdicts. No photos gives all-UNCERTAIN and a human review; a model failure gives a pending record, never a guess.
notes: In-process by default; also serves GET /health and POST /run: uvicorn agents.receiving.app:app --port 8101. Needs Node 20+, a one-time `npm ci` in agents/receiving/round2, and GEMINI_API_KEY in .env. Captures: data/input/<unit>/receiving/*.jpg (role from the file name: pallet, carton, unit, label).
